name: @ui8kit/facet-search
description: A faceted search engine over a static index whose facets are data (a vocabulary): multi-select within a facet, AND across facets, disjunctive counts, collapsed variants, soft (ranking) facets, word-prefix text search in any script, sorts, zero-result relaxations and a canonical URL. One pure function `search(engine, state)` for the browser, a server or an MCP tool. Plain TypeScript, no UI, no build step. Moved from apps/stock (S2); Stock reads it, the Magazine can later.
